lines.text: You passed the test? Big W!

data.define: Used to celebrate a success or good result.

example.text: You passed the test? Big W!

misuse.text: Don't say 'big W' to someone who lost.

native.tip: “big W” = grande vitória; vitória incrível; sucesso. Exemplo: “You passed the test? Big W!”
